scope: Resolve the two remaining PriChan sticker-coloring two-book set candidates without treating character-family similarity as publisher evidence.

reviewed.reason: No exact ISBN, volume pair, mandatory publisher field, or official book record was found that binds this exact two-book set to 유니콘. Public marketplace results show multiple PriChan coloring/sticker publications from 은하수미디어, 도서출판 신세계, 두드림엠앤비, 학산문화사 and 유니콘, so title-family similarity is insufficient.

The indexed Coupang page confirms the exact product identity and seller but exposes no publisher value in the searchable mandatory-information text. Public search results show competing PriChan publishers and do not identify the two component editions, so an exact 유니콘 publisher determination cannot be made.

evidence.finding: Exact productId-itemId and title confirmed; searchable page text does not expose publisher.
Same character family contains products attributed to 은하수미디어, 도서출판 신세계, 두드림엠앤비, 학산문화사 and 유니콘; therefore character/title family is not a valid exact publisher key.
Official PriChan coloring record exists for 은하수미디어, confirming competing official publisher records in this title family.
